observation_rules: Never overwrite a source observation with an adjudication.
Photograph, plate/drawing, occurrence tracing, transcription, and analytical inference are distinct evidence levels.
SigLA-derived tracings retain SigLA CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 provenance.
A normalized word boundary is not evidence that a physical divider exists.
Canonical sign identity does not itself establish a palaeographic variant.
Proposed phonetic values and metrological values remain interpretation/hypothesis unless independently established.

analysis_gates.accounting: exclude or branch on unresolved HT17 numeral; document HT10a provisional status
